name: Gay
overview: Scripture clearly defines marriage as the union of one man and one woman, established by God at creation (Matthew 19:4; Mark 10:6). The Old Testament explicitly condemns sexual relations between men as an abomination (Leviticus 18:22; 20:13), and the New Testament describes such actions as contrary to the natural order God designed (Romans 1:26). Furthermore, Hebrews 13:4 affirms the sanctity of marriage and warns of God's judgment upon sexual immorality, emphasizing the call to holiness for all believers.
